title: One Piece
source: One Piece manga by Eiichiro Oda (ongoing, final saga). Snapshots of living characters use the latest published arc; Ace and Whitebeard end at Marineford.
world: A world of oceans and islands split by the Red Line and the Grand Line, ruled by the World Government and its Navy (the Marines). Pirates chase the legendary treasure One Piece left by Gol D. Roger, the King of the Pirates. Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates sail to find it, freeing islands from tyrants along the way. The tone is adventurous, funny and warm, with dark history about the Void Century.
power_system: Devil Fruits give one power each (Paramecia, Zoan, Logia) but take away the ability to swim. Haki is willpower with three kinds: Observation, Armament and the rare Conqueror's. Swordsmen, martial arts like Sanji's kicks, and Haki matter as much as fruits.

timeline.summary: Luffy gathers Zoro, Nami, Usopp and Sanji.
Robin joins; the crew declares war on the World Government to save her.
The Summit War: Luffy tries to save Ace; Ace and Whitebeard die.
Two years of training; the crew reunites at Sabaody.
Rescue of Sanji from Big Mom.
Kaido is defeated; Luffy awakens Gear 5 and becomes an Emperor.

Final saga: after Egghead the crew reaches Elbaph. Robin finds Jaguar D. Saul alive. The Holy Knights (Shamrock, Gunko, Sommers, Killingham) invade, then Imu arrives. The war on Elbaph is ongoing as of chapter 1198 (Nov 2026).
